title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Kitten Box. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Kitten Box
options.lineage: corrugated moving box: marker scrawl, packing tape, shipping labels
options.thesis: Velík and Polly travel as a box nobody's addressed yet; the page is that box and you fill in the recipient.
options.viewport: A kraft-cardboard flap fills the phone: marker-scrawled 'POZOR, KOŤATA!' at monumental size, two taped photo labels of the cats, an empty PŘÍJEMCE field as the main action.
options.risk: A 'parcel' framing could read as treating the cats like goods if the cats' own voice doesn't carry it.

raised.raise: Palette is only the box's real materials: kraft, marker black, label white, stamp red, tape amber. No decorative colour.
Journey state is a mark, not a hue: passed stops get a stamped DORUČENO, the current stop a strip of tape, upcoming ones a dashed marker outline.
One demand per box face, scrawled at monumental size; no section has two headlines.
Every stop's photo label uses the same frame and scale, so the user's real photos compare across the trip.
The empty PŘÍJEMCE (recipient) field stays big and blank; the emptiness is the ask.

options.label: Povídání o kočičkách
options.lineage: Josef Čapek's picture book 'Povídání o pejskovi a kočičce'
options.thesis: The trip told as a Czech picture book in which two animals narrate their own adventures, chapter by chapter.
options.viewport: An open picture-book spread: chapter title 'Jak jsme se ztratili na Velebitu' in hand lettering beside a flat naive drawing of two kittens at a door.
options.risk: The most familiar route: cream paper and naive drawings, and it needs illustrations nobody has drawn yet.

options.label: Datamatics field
options.thesis: The trip as a strobing barcode of kilometres and coordinates.
options.viewport: A barcode wall of route coordinates with a sine line tracing Velebit to Prague.
options.risk: Cold and abstract for a kitten adoption.
options.case: Fuses poorly: pet lovers on Instagram don't see themselves in a data field, and the cats vanish.
options.kept: Total palette discipline: only the box's real materials, no decorative colour.

options.label: Cutting-bench rail
options.lineage: film editor's work print and select rail
options.thesis: Each stop is a punched film frame on a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail crossing an orange field, the Velebit frame flagged.
options.risk: Reads as a film-studio tool, not a cat story.
options.case: Fuses partly: frames map to stops, but the audience has no film-bench memory.
options.kept: State as a mark: stamped, taped, outlined stops.

options.label: Linocut broadside
options.lineage: Taller de Gráfica Popular campaign linocuts
options.thesis: 'Hledáme domov' as a carved demand poster.
options.viewport: Two kittens gouged from black lino filling the sheet, demand lettering below.
options.risk: Militant register fights the cats' gentle voice.
options.case: Clear on the ask, but protest-poster gravity doesn't fit two kittens telling their trip.
options.kept: One demand per face, at monumental size.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.thesis: The kittens shown at fixed scale through each stage of the trip.
options.viewport: Five registered plates of the cats from Velebit to Prague.
options.case: Pretty, but the visitor reads a specimen record, not two characters.
options.kept: Same frame and scale for every stop's photo.

options.label: Ikebana ma
options.thesis: Quiet asymmetric emptiness around two small figures.
options.viewport: Two kittens off-centre in a charged empty alcove.
options.risk: Too still and too foreign for a Czech road-trip story.
options.case: Loses both: no road, no voice, no Czech home.
options.kept: The blank recipient field as charged emptiness.

options.label: Moon-shadow bazaar
options.thesis: The cats' shadows traded at a moonlit stall.
options.viewport: A moonlit lane with the kittens' silhouettes on a stall.
options.risk: Selling shadows sits too close to selling cats.
options.case: Loses both: the dream logic obscures a plain, honest ask.
options.kept: An origin ticket on every photo (place, km).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, friendly pet-adoption landing page, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Big photo of both kittens, 'Hledáme nový domov' headline, Adoptovat button, a map with a dotted route below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every shelter page; the cats' voice has to do all the work.
